evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'let's go ahead and get you quoted. So I'll just ask a few questions and provide you an accurate estimate. Is that okay?' — no time-box given, no 'dependable quote' promise, no real pause for acceptance before moving to name/date questions.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Bradley Fishel) asked and confirmed; moving date (Saturday) established; address gathered (23026 Man Grove drive, San Antonio 78260); however, no explicit city-to-city route (it's an intra-house move), and approximate size/room count never probed — customer volunteered furniture piece counts but rep did not ask 'how many rooms' or 'what size home.'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep launches straight into logistics without asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move' or equivalent. Customer volunteers a concern late (hip replacement preventing self-work) but it was unsolicited.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathered item-specific details (sectional, couch, bunk bed, coffee table) but did not probe property type, floor count, room count, walking distance, additional rooms, special considerations beyond the hip replacement, or additional stops. Minimal probing for the context needed to refine the estimate.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not applicable to a furniture-move job; not asked.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives '$206 per hour per two movers' and calculates to '$655' for 2.5 hours, then adds $70 trip fee. No typical-range anchor for a home this size, no personalization to customer's stated prep or concerns (hip replacement mentioned but not reflected in estimate framing).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip fee disclosed ($70), materials/taxes/fuel disclosed as included. Missing: no 2.5-hour-minimum restatement (it was mentioned early but not tied to the pricing), no 15-minute-increments framing, no 'not a guess' commitment language.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moves directly from 'everything is included there' to 'would you like me to go ahead and schedule' without asking 'does that feel fair?' or equivalent, and without holding silence.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No Two Promises section delivered at all. Rep does not ask 'does that put those to rest?' or similar.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway. Rep asks 'will there be anything else sir that I can help you with today?' — generic close-out question, not a genuine 'what's still concerning you' check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about' type of question.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Yes, explicit: 'So would you like our help with your move on? I mean, with, you know, with the job on Saturday?' — plainly asked, no built-in out.

top_strength: Rep successfully secured the booking with a clean explicit ask and confirmed the date, time, and address despite minimal discovery and no Two Promises delivery.
coaching_note: Skip the welcome chatter and lead with the quid pro quo framing (time-box + dependable quote promise); then ask 'what are your biggest concerns' before diving into logistics — you missed discovering their real priorities and never delivered the two core promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) that close deals.
